> Ingredients:
> 4 large heads of Iceberg lettuce, outer leaves removed and washed
> Chunky Heinz Tomato Sauce (from U.K.) - if you live outside U.S., just substitute any ketchup with Tabasco sauce added
> Prawns (shrimp) deveined & peeled
> Lemon Juice
> Sea Salt to taste
> Ground Black Pepper to taste
> Cooking Instructions:

It was one of dozens of variants on prawn cocktails that pop up when I search Google or Blogger for food combinations containing shrimps and tomatoes, often interspersed with recipes for things as diverse as "Russian Salad," Mexican Beef Nachos", "Lamb Burgers" ...
